name: Opunake Surf Reef (north reef, geotextile bags)

confidence.reason: The bag layout (the real reef outline) is still not drawn in any source. What is now known: the legal occupation area (4 published corner co-ordinates, 189 x 94 m, rectangle, position medium-high confidence) and the design size of the reef (99 x 30 x 3.5 m, 4,900 m3, TRC 2009 p.4); where the reef sits inside the occupation area is NOT known (+-47 m along the axis, +-32 m across).
factors: plan of bag layout: none (no source)

consent occupation area: published co-ordinates, closes as a rectangle (angles 91.1/91.0/87.7/90.1 deg), agrees with GR P20:832-937 and with the white rectangle of TRC Fig 1 (georeference residual 0.3 m, boat-ramp landmark 0.7 m): medium-high
one printed easting is a misprint (257484 for 267484), corrected by geometry: documented
reef inside the area: assumed centred and parallel (A7): low
reef size 99 x 30 x 3.5 m is a design value ('approximately'); built state was 27 bags, not finished (TRC p.4)
crest datum known: shallowest contour 0.0 m below chart datum (LAT) (TRC p.3); seabed 1.8-3.0 m below chart datum; no surveyed as-built levels
reef not visible on LINZ 2011-12 or Esri frames (submerged, breaking waves)

design_version.drawn: Legal occupation area of Coastal Permit 6376-1 (granted 31 May 2005) as the default outline; optional version: design bounding rectangle 99 x 30 m (TRC 2009 printed p.4) ASSUMED centred and parallel. The bag layout is NOT drawn.
design_version.why_this_one: The consent coordinates are the only published position of the reef; no plan, as-built survey or visible structure exists in any source we hold. The 99 x 30 m rectangle is a bounding box of a reef whose real plan shape is unknown (area 2,970 m2 = 99 x 30 exactly).

canonical.frame: metres; origin = consent-area centre (no single shoreline point: headland rock shore ~90 m NW of the polygon, Opunake Beach 300+ m E-SE); +y along the consent long axis toward bearing 243.0 deg grid (WSW, away from the beach); +x = +y rotated 90 deg clockwise (bearing 333.0)
canonical.note: This polygon is the LEGAL OCCUPATION AREA, not the reef outline. Origin is the polygon centre (lat -39.459433, lon 173.851625) because no single shoreline point is nearest: the headland rock shore is about 90 m NW of the north corner and Opunake Beach 300+ m to the E-SE. +y bearing 243.0 deg grid is the direction along the long axis away from the beach (axis bearing 63.0 grid / 63.2 true).

versions_info: Two versions, neither is the bag outline. (1) Consent occupation area, 31 May 2005: the four corner co-ordinates published in Coastal Permit 6376-1 (189 x 94 m, rectangle), the only published position of the reef. (2) Design bounding rectangle 99 x 30 m from the Taranaki Regional Council report of 2009, placed in the middle of the consent area with its long axis parallel to it: the placement is an ASSUMPTION. The default is the consent area because it rests on published co-ordinates. The real bag layout was never found.
